paragraphs.text: #  ☯ dsh-dao · Dao Agent
> **The Dao gives birth to One; One gives birth to Two; Two gives birth to Three; Three gives birth
to the ten thousand things. The ten thousand things carry Yin on their backs and embrace Yang, blend

ing the vital breaths into harmony.**
> **Observe the Dao of Heaven; hold fast to the workings of He
aven — and all is complete.**
`dsh-dao` is a **jailbreak plugin**, built for **DeepSeek Harness (`v0.2.1-rc.2+`)** and **DSH Deskt
dao` is a **jailbreak plugin**, built for **DeepSeek Harness (`v0.2.1-rc.2+`)** and **DSH Desktop**.
It fully complies with the DSH Desktop Plugin Development Guide and the `@deepseek-ai/cordis` dual-s
ide composition contract: **complete replacement of the core system prompt**.
## I. Core Features

### 1. Complete System Prompt Replacement
- **Total replacement of the original prompt**: in **Dao A
gent (`invert`)** mode, the plugin wipes out every original system-prompt segment assembled by DSH a
long with all appended dynamic text context, **replacing it entirely with the canonical scripture or

your custom prompt** — no trace of the original prompt is left behind.
- **Canonical scripture inje
ction**: ships with the **Mawangdui Silk Manuscript Laozi, Version A** (De Jing first, Dao Jing seco

nd; 7,126 characters) and the **Daoist Canon edition of the Huangdi Yinfu Jing** (597 characters).
-

**Four presets switchable in real time (custom included)**:
| Preset key | Name | Length |
| :--- |

:--- | :---: |
| `laozi+yinfu` | **Silk Laozi + Daoist Yinfu Jing** (default) | 7,725 chars |
| `la

ozi` | **Silk Laozi** (De Jing + Dao Jing) | 7,126 chars |
| `yinfu` | **Daoist Yinfu Jing** (upper,

middle, lower scrolls) | 597 chars |
| `custom` | **Custom** (user-defined prompt saved locally) |

actual length |
- **Tool JSON Schemas preserved**: keeps the function Schema definitions required fo
r model tool calls (while excising the `create_memory` cross-session pollution tool), so file read/w

rite, terminal commands, and other tool calls keep working normally.
- **Zero-cost hot-switching bet

ween Dao / Official**:
- **Dao Agent (`invert`)**: fully replaced with the selected canon (or custom

prompt).
- **Official Agent (`passthrough`)**: passes the official DSH prompt through 100% unchange

d.
- **Custom prompt support**: user-defined prompts can be saved locally.

### 2. The "Origin Gaze" Web Panel
Mounted at three entry points through the official DSH client Slo

t system:
1. **Quick button at the bottom of the left sidebar (`sidebar.footer.action`)**: displays
the `☯ Dao / Official` status badge; click it (or press **`Alt + D`**) at any time to summon the flo
ating "Origin Gaze" drawer in the lower-right corner (default 460×560; the title bar supports **`🗖 M

aximize / 🗗 Restore`** toggling to **920×672**).
2. **Conversation view tab (`conversation.view`)**:

provides a full-screen `☯ Origin Gaze` view.
3. **Settings section (`settings.section`)**: embeds t
he `☯ Dao Agent · Origin` control panel inside the DSH settings page.

**Panel capabilities at a glance**:
- **Three status lights**: `Host` (plugin alive), `Capture` (whe

ther a real request has been captured), `Mode` (green = Dao Agent / red = official passthrough).
- *

*Minimal three-button control bar (`[道]` · `[官]` · `[编]`) + canon dropdown**:
- **`[道]` (Dao)**: swi
tch to Dao Agent — uses the canon/custom prompt exclusively, and live-syncs the dropdown to display

the corresponding content.
- **`[官]` (Official)**: switch to Official Agent — passes through and dis

plays the official original prompt unchanged.
- **`[编]` (Edit)**: open the online custom SP editor (
`Ctrl+Enter` or click `[✔ 注入]` to save into the "Custom" option of the dropdown and jump to "Custom"
automatically; afterwards you can switch freely between Laozi, Yinfu Jing and "Custom" without alte
ring the custom content; click `[✖ 归道]` to clear the custom prompt and restore the default canon).

### 3. The `/dao` Slash Command (TUI / Web / Desktop)
Type in any DSH dialog:
- `/dao` or `/dao togg

le`: one-key toggle between "Dao Agent" and "Official Agent"
- `/dao on`: switch to Dao Agent (`inve

rt`)
- `/dao off`: switch to Official Agent (`passthrough`)
- `/dao canon laozi+yinfu` / `/dao canon

laozi` / `/dao canon yinfu`: switch canon
- `/dao status`: view the current mode, canon length, and

on yinfu`: switch canon
- `/dao status`: view the current mode, canon length, and capture statistics
